assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent character illustration for a Chinese programming-learning website weekly planning section.
Primary request: Faithfully redraw the character and chair from the attached low-resolution reference with a clean genuinely transparent background. The reference is subject and composition guidance, not a finished image to copy.
Subject: a cheerful golden yellow egg-shaped toy mascot with round cream face, large gentle dark eyes, tiny surprised/happy mouth, a small yellow ball antenna, mitten hands and two short legs in white knitted boots. Seated in a comfortable warm orange-yellow armchair and holding an open small dark teal programming book with simple abstract blocks on the pages. Slight three-quarter front view. Preserve the recognizable egg-shaped face and body proportions, both visible white boots, chair arms and short chair legs. The book cover must be clean and unbranded with no text.
Style: polished 3D toy illustration matching the user's supplied yellow egg mascot, soft matte vinyl body, restrained knitted boot texture, gentle studio highlights. Friendly calm studying pose, clean silhouette.
Composition: square canvas, complete character and complete chair centered with around 8% transparent margin on all sides, no clipping, read clearly at 150–220px.
Background: genuine alpha transparency. Preserve opaque cream face and white boots. No checkerboard pixels, no paper, no watermark, no scenery, no cast shadow or floor. No logos, readable text, extra characters or props beyond the book and chair.

Dark blue over-ear headset with pale ear pads and a thin white microphone boom ending in a dark mic near its mouth. Relaxed half-lidded eyes looking slightly sideways, small curved worried eyebrows and one simple blue sweat drop on cheek. Mildly puzzled rather than distressed, like waiting for a connection to resume.
Style: polished soft 3D toy illustration matching the supplied toy characters, matte gray vinyl body, gentle studio highlights, restrained boot texture, clean friendly silhouette. Preserve the recognizable facial proportions and headset silhouette.
Composition: square canvas, complete character centered with around 8% transparent margins on all sides, full antenna, ear cups and boots visible, no clipping, readable at 140px.
Background: actual alpha transparency. Preserve opaque cream face and white boots. Remove all checkerboard, faint overlays and background. No external cast shadow, floor, scenery, watermark, text, logos, other objects or extra limbs.
